title: Service-first XTP admission
summary: XTP FIRST carries the canonical named service; after admission the context uses KEY/DATA. L2, raw36 and UDP are carriers, not service identities.
invariants: Canonical service identity and operational class originate in the Service Descriptor Registry, not caller assertions.
Route peer is resolved from the registry and route policy; UDP 62801 is a carrier setting only.
Admission, authentication and operational policy must occur before a context or work is accepted.
RTO2.<MI> is a Queue Fabric receiver channel, NOT the canonical XTP service descriptor.
Dev25 named-service support in the wider Grid is not field-qualified by the candidate2 smoke runner.

provenance.claim: Explicit separation of Queue channel and native named service
